propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stock argparse.HelpFormatter instead of RebarHelpFormatter, causing width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and py3.13 help-rendering staleness risk identical to the S2d regression
Canonical help artifacts for bridge-fsck.txt are generated at width-78 (stdlib default) while bridge.txt uses width-80 (RebarHelpFormatter), inconsistent within the same command family
Any py3.13 argparse divergence in short+long metavar rendering or usage wrapping in these four factories would silently make gen_cli_help.py --check stale on py3.13-only, replicating the S2d failure
RebarHelpFormatter pinning via contract test ensures no help-backed (rendered) route factory uses a formatter not subclassing RebarHelpFormatter, preventing reintroduction of the regression trap
Switching the four factories to RebarHelpFormatter and regenerating artifacts yields width-80 canonical form with byte-identical stability across py3.11/py3.12/py3.13
Intercept-group advanced parsers are out of scope: gen_cli_help.py never renders them and gen_cli_reference.py already canonicalizes their cross-version help via _unwrap_usage and _collapse_metavars
